name: Decay
description: At the start of each of this unit's turns, every unit within %radius% tile takes %health_steal% damage and permanently loses %health_steal% maximum health and %str_steal% strength, all transferred to this unit.
details: Allies are drained exactly as enemies are - the rot does not tell friend from foe.

upgrade.summary: A second, wider rot drains %aura_health_steal% more health from enemies within %aura_radius% tiles.
details: Allies are drained by the inner rot exactly as enemies are - it does not tell friend from foe.
The outer rot reaches %aura_radius% tiles but touches enemies only, taking %aura_health_steal% health and maximum health.
The two stack: an adjacent enemy sits in both, losing %health_steal% and %aura_health_steal% health along with %str_steal% strength.
